caption:
बॉक्स ऑफिस पर शनिवार को Ranbir Kapoor की फिल्म Ramayana ने ऐसा गदर मचाया कि हर कोई देखता रह गया! 🔥

Nitesh Tiwari के डायरेक्शन और Namit Malhotra के प्रोडक्शन में बनी फिल्म Ramayana ने अपने तीसरे दिन दुनियाभर में कुल ₹375.50 crore gross बटोरे हैं।

भारत में शनिवार को फिल्म ने ₹83.45 crore gross कमाए, जो शुक्रवार के ₹57.30 crore से पूरे 45.3% ज्यादा हैं। इसी के साथ ओवरसीज से कुल कमाई ₹157.25 crore तक पहुंच गई है। 💥

इस धमाकेदार आंकड़े के साथ Ramayana ने तीसरे दिन कमाई के मामले में Adipurush (₹304.04 crore), Pathaan (₹313 crore) और Animal (₹356.05 crore) को पीछे छोड़ दिया है। हालांकि, यह Jawan के ₹383.18 crore के रिकॉर्ड से थोड़ी पीछे रह गई।

Sai Pallavi, Yash, Sunny Deol और Ravi Dubey जैसे बड़े सितारों से सजी इस फिल्म के सीक्वल की रिलीज को अब 2027 के बजाय 2028 के लिए तय किया गया है। 🎬

क्या आपको लगता है कि Ramayana आने वाले दिनों में Jawan का रिकॉर्ड तोड़ पाएगी? अपनी राय कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 💬

ctx.title: Ramayana worldwide box office collection day 3: Saturday surge takes Ranbir Kapoor's film past  ₹375 crore, beats Adipurush, Pathaan and Animal
ctx.summary: Starring Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi in the lead roles, the film is directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra.
ctx.text:
After a slower first Friday, Ramayana : Part One, starring Ranbir Kapoor , Yash and Sai Pallavi, has picked up pace at the box office, with Saturday bringing a big jump in collections. The Nitesh Tiwari directorial earned its biggest single-day worldwide earnings since release. With its three-day worldwide gross touching ₹ 375 crore, the film has already put up some impressive numbers and is now closing in on the Day 3 record of Shah Rukh Khan's Jawan.
According to trade tracker Sacnilk, the film had a strong Saturday, collecting ₹ 83.45 crore gross in India. Overseas markets added another ₹ 60 crore on the day, taking the film's total overseas gross to ₹ 157.25 crore. Its worldwide gross now stands at ₹ 375.50 crore.
The jump is particularly noticeable when compared to Friday's numbers. Ramayana collected ₹ 57.30 crore gross in India on day 2, which means Saturday saw a 45.3% rise. The film has also gone past its opening-day India gross of ₹ 77.50 crore, making Day 3 its biggest day at the domestic box office so far.
Ramayana's third-day worldwide gross has already taken it past the numbers of some major Indian films. Adipurush, which also told the tale of Ramayana starring Prabhas and Kriti Sanon, had collected ₹ 304.04 crore worldwide on day 3. With that collection, Ramayana is ahead by approximately 23.5%.
The film has also beaten the third-day worldwide collection of Shah Rukh Khan's Pathaan, which stood at ₹ 313 crore. Ranbir Kapoor's Animal had earned ₹ 356.05 crore worldwide on its third day, which his latest has surpassed.
However, Jawan remains the film to beat. Shah Rukh Khan's blockbuster had collected ₹ 383.18 crore worldwide on day 3 whereas Dhurandhar: The Revenge starring Ranveer Singh had surpassed over ₹ 500 crore mark worldwide by the third day.
Sunday will be an important day for Ramayana, although Diwali celebrations could affect theatre footfalls, particularly during evening and night shows. The bigger opportunity may come after the festival, when the holiday period could bring more families to theatres. Monday's collections will be worth watching, especially after the strong Saturday performance.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit Malhotra, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita and Yash as Ravana. Sunny Deol plays Lord Hanuman, while Ravi Dubey portrays Lakshman. The ensemble also features Arun Govil, Lara Dutta, Rakul Preet Singh, Kajal Aggarwal, Indira Krishnan, and Kunal Kapoor. The sequel has been confirmed for 2028 release instead of 2027.
